_meta.description: Orthodox saints keyed by Old-Style (Julian) calendar date MM-DD. New-Style (Gregorian civil) dates are computed at runtime per year via the century-aware Julian->Gregorian offset.
_meta.rank_scale: 1 (highest, Great Feast) .. 6 (lowest, simple commemoration) per the Typikon

saints.name: St. Basil the Great
saints.notes: Archbishop of Caesarea; Circumcision of the Lord is also commemorated this day.

saints.name: St. Gregory the Theologian
saints.notes: Archbishop of Constantinople, one of the Three Hierarchs.

saints.name: St. John Chrysostom (Translation of Relics)
saints.notes: Archbishop of Constantinople; principal feast Nov 13.

saints.name: Synaxis of the Three Hierarchs
saints.notes: Sts. Basil the Great, Gregory the Theologian, and John Chrysostom together.

saints.name: The Forty Martyrs of Sebaste
saints.notes: Soldiers martyred on a frozen lake in Armenia (c. 320).

saints.name: St. George the Great Martyr
saints.notes: The Trophy-bearer; one of the most venerated military martyrs.

saints.name: St. Mark the Apostle and Evangelist
saints.notes: Author of the Gospel of Mark.

saints.name: St. John the Theologian (Apostle and Evangelist)
saints.notes: The Beloved Disciple; also commemorated Sep 26.

saints.name: Sts. Cyril and Methodius, Equals-to-the-Apostles
saints.notes: Enlighteners of the Slavs.

saints.name: Sts. Constantine and Helen, Equals-to-the-Apostles
saints.notes: Emperor Constantine and his mother Helen, finder of the True Cross.

saints.name: Nativity of St. John the Forerunner
saints.notes: Birth of the Baptist.

saints.name: Holy Apostles Peter and Paul
saints.notes: The Chief Apostles; conclusion of the Apostles' Fast.

saints.name: Synaxis of the Twelve Apostles
saints.notes: Peter, Andrew, James (Zebedee), John, Philip, Bartholomew, Thomas, Matthew, James (Alphaeus), Jude (Thaddaeus), Simon the Zealot, Matthias.

saints.name: Sts. Cosmas and Damian the Unmercenaries (of Rome)
saints.notes: Physicians who healed without payment.

saints.name: Holy Prophet Elias (Elijah)
saints.notes: The Tishbite prophet taken up in a fiery chariot.

saints.name: Dormition of St. Anna, Mother of the Theotokos
saints.notes: Mother of the Most Holy Theotokos.

saints.name: Beheading of St. John the Forerunner
saints.notes: Strict fast day.

saints.name: Repose of St. John the Theologian
saints.notes: Apostle and Evangelist; principal feast.

saints.name: Protection of the Theotokos (Pokrov)
saints.notes: Commemorates the appearance of the Theotokos at Blachernae.

saints.name: Holy Apostle James, son of Alphaeus
saints.notes: One of the Twelve.

saints.name: St. Demetrius the Great Martyr (Myrrh-streaming)
saints.notes: Myrrh-streaming martyr of Thessalonica.

saints.name: Synaxis of the Archangel Michael and the Bodiless Powers
saints.notes: Chief of the heavenly hosts.

saints.name: St. John Chrysostom, Archbishop of Constantinople
saints.notes: Author of the Divine Liturgy most commonly served.

saints.name: Holy Apostle Philip
saints.notes: One of the Twelve; eve of the Nativity Fast.

saints.name: Holy Apostle and Evangelist Matthew
saints.notes: Author of the Gospel of Matthew.

saints.name: Holy Apostle Andrew the First-Called
saints.notes: First-called of the Twelve; brother of Peter.

saints.name: St. Nicholas the Wonderworker, Archbishop of Myra
saints.notes: Defender of Orthodoxy at Nicaea; beloved wonderworker.

saints.name: St. Herman of Alaska
saints.notes: Wonderworker and enlightener of North America (also commemorated Aug 9).

saints.name: Royal Martyrs of Russia (Tsar Nicholas II and family)
saints.notes: New Martyrs and Passion-bearers (1918).

saints.name: Sts. Cosmas and Damian the Unmercenaries (of Asia)
saints.notes: Wonderworking physicians of Asia Minor.

saints.name: Holy Apostle James, the Brother of the Lord
saints.notes: First Bishop of Jerusalem; author of the Liturgy of St. James.

saints.name: Holy Apostles Bartholomew and Barnabas
saints.notes: Bartholomew, one of the Twelve; Barnabas of the Seventy.

saints.name: Holy Apostle Thomas
saints.notes: One of the Twelve; the formerly-doubting apostle.

saints.name: Holy Apostle Matthias
saints.notes: Chosen to replace Judas among the Twelve.

saints.name: Holy Apostle Simon the Zealot
saints.notes: One of the Twelve.

saints.name: Holy Apostle Jude (Thaddaeus), Brother of the Lord
saints.notes: One of the Twelve; author of the Epistle of Jude.
